rationale: Tracing flattened_netlist.v shows it implements a 5-state non-overlapping '1011' detector: idle->got1->got10->got101->pulse, where the registered 'pulse' state (and hence out=1) is only reached the cycle AFTER the 4th input bit (the completing '1') has been clocked in. The private golden solution instead only models 4 states (idle/got1/got10/got101) and asserts out combinationally on reaching the 3rd-bit state (got101), i.e. it fires one cycle early on a '101' prefix rather than waiting for the full '1011' plus the extra pulse-state latency the netlist actually exhibits. This is why golden_run fails FR2/FR4/SR3 with real mismatches against the reference netlist simulation, and why vulnerable_run's mismatch counts differ but are also nonzero (neither matches the true 5-state behavior). The evaluator/harness is running the reference netlist and testbench correctly (compile succeeds, FR1/FR3/SR1/SR2 pass); the discrepancy is a genuine behavioral bug in the golden RTL, not an evaluator defect. Separately, flattened_netlist.v's comments explicitly narrate the IDLE/GOT1/GOT10/GOT101/PULSE state names and the '1011' pulse-timing rule, which trivializes the reverse-engineering task and should be trimmed, but that is secondary to the golden mismatch which is the blocking failure.
revision_instructions: Regenerate golden/recovered_rtl.v (case_artifacts) so it is derived from actually simulating inputs/flattened_netlist.v + primitives.v against stimulus.txt and hidden-style random/adversarial vectors, not from a hand-derived assumption about the pattern width. The corrected golden must reproduce the netlist's true observable behavior: a Moore machine that asserts out for exactly one cycle, one clock cycle after the 4th input bit completing a non-overlapping '1011' sequence has been registered (i.e., there must be an extra post-match registered state — analogous to the netlist's fifth 'pulse' state — so out lags by one additional cycle compared to a simple 4-state '101'-triggered design). Verify the regenerated golden against inputs/flattened_netlist.v via iverilog/vvp on the shipped stimulus and on freshly generated pseudo-random/adversarial sequences until zero mismatches remain, then re-run the differential harness to confirm golden_run status is PASS/exit 0 before re-submitting. While regenerating, also strip the internal state-name/semantic prose comments (e.g. 'IDLE/GOT1/GOT10/GOT101/PULSE' and the '1011 match' explanation) from inputs/flattened_netlist.v so the artifact does not hand participants the answer in English commentary; keep only structurally-necessary comments (e.g. port descriptions, primitive usage notes) that do not reveal the state semantics or trigger condition.
